learnings: API errors during file audits should trigger automatic retries or fallback to alternative models rather than marking the entire audit as inconclusive

The initial PKGBUILD audit (performed before source download) provides valuable safety information even when the full audit fails - this partial result should be weighted more heavily in the final verdict
Tool infrastructure should distinguish between 'audit found no issues' and 'audit could not complete' - the latter should not be treated as equivalent to 'inconclusive security finding'
